verdict.rationale: The evidence describes an OpenAPI-described Conductor HTTP API and a strategy for versioning users' own workflow code. Neither shows that DBOS's APIs are versioned or that DBOS publishes a deprecation policy. Workflow-code patching and versioning is a different capability from API versioning, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
